title: Row Boat Rental 🛶

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Experience Central Park like never before with our rowboat rentals. Whether you’re planning a romantic date, a fun family outing, or a peaceful solo escape, our rowboats offer a unique way to enjoy the park’s serene beauty. Please note that rowboats are non-reservable and on a first come, first served basis. Your safety is our priority. Life jackets are provided with every rental, and children under 12 must be accompanied by an adult. Children must be at least 3 feet tall to ride. Brunch Sunday 11am-3pm Lunch Monday-Saturday 11am-4PM Dinner Monday-Saturday 4pm-9pm Sunday
